lines.gurmukhi: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ukat siaanap sagalee tiaag ||
lines.translation: Give up all your clever tricks and devices,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee charanee laag ||2||
lines.translation: and hold tight to the Feet of the Saints. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਹਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab jee hahi jaa kai haath ||
lines.translation: The One, who holds all creatures in His Hands,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kade na vichhuRai sabh kai saath ||
lines.translation: is never separated from them; He is with them all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਵ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: upaav chhod gahu tis kee ot ||
lines.translation: Abandon your clever devices, and grasp hold of His Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਛੋਟਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nimakh maahi hovai teree chhot ||3||
lines.translation: In an instant, you shall be saved. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa nikat kar tis no jaan ||
lines.translation: Know that He is always near at hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa sat kar maan ||
lines.translation: Accept the Order of God as True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ ਆਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan mitaavahu aap ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, eradicate selfishness and conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੩॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam naanak jap jaap ||4||4||73||
lines.translation: O Nanak, chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||4||73||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan sadaa abinaasee ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Word is eternal and everlasting.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan katee jam phaasee ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Word cuts away the noose of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan jee kai sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Word is always with the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਚੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan rachai raam kai ra(n)g ||1||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, one is immersed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo gur deeaa s man kai kaam ||
lines.translation: Whatever the Guru gives, is useful to the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t kaa keeaa sat kar maan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever the Saint does - accept that as True. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਅਟਲ ਅਛੇਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan atal achhed ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Word is infallible and unchanging.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਟੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੇਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan kate bhram bhed ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, doubt and prejudice are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan katahu na jaai ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Word never goes away;

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan har ke gun gaai ||2||
lines.translation: through the Guru's Word, we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan jee kai saath ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Word accompanies the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan anaath ko naath ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Word is the Master of the masterless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan narak na pavai ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Word saves one from falling into hell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan rasanaa a(n)mrit ravai ||3||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, the tongue savors the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan paragat sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Word is revealed in the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan na aavai haar ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, no one suffers defeat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis jan hoe aap kripaal ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True Guru is always kind and compassionate,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥੫॥੭੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur sadaa daiaal ||4||5||74||
lines.translation: Unto those whom the Lord Himself has blessed with His Mercy. ||4||5||74||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਤੇ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin keetaa maatee te ratan ||
lines.translation: He makes jewels out of the dust,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: garabh mahi raakhiaa jin kar jatan ||
lines.translation: and He managed to preserve you in the womb.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin deenee sobhaa vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: He has given you fame and greatness;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tis prabh kau aath pahar dhiaaee ||1||
lines.translation: meditate on that God, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਮਈਆ ਰੇਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ramaeeaa ren saadh jan paavau ||
lines.translation: O Lord, I seek the dust of the feet of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur mil apunaa khasam dhiaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meeting the Guru, I meditate on my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਮੂੜ ਤੇ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin keetaa mooR te bakataa ||
lines.translation: He transformed me, the fool, into a fine speaker,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਬੇਸੁਰਤ ਤੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin keetaa besurat te surataa ||
lines.translation: and He made the unconscious become conscious;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis parasaad navai nidh paaee ||
lines.translation: by His Grace, I have obtained the nine treasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh man te bisarat naahee ||2||
lines.translation: May I never forget that God from my mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin deeaa nithaave kau thaan ||
lines.translation: He has given a home to the homeless;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin deeaa nimaane kau maan ||
lines.translation: He has given honor to the dishonored.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin keenee sabh pooran aasaa ||
lines.translation: He has fulfilled all desires;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: simarau din rain saas giraasaa ||3||
lines.translation: remember Him in meditation, day and night, with every breath and every morsel of food. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਿਲਕ ਕਾਟੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis prasaad maaiaa silak kaatee ||
lines.translation: By His Grace, the bonds of Maya are cut away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਟੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad a(n)mrit bikh khaatee ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the bitter poison has become Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak is te kichh naahee ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I cannot do anything;

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੭੫॥
lines.transliteration: raakhanahaare kau saalaahee ||4||6||75||
lines.translation: I praise the Lord, the Protector. ||4||6||75||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kee saran naahee bhau sog ||
lines.translation: In His Sanctuary, there is no fear or sorrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: us te baahar kachhoo na hog ||
lines.translation: Without Him, nothing at all can be done.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜੀ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: tajee siaanap bal budh bikaar ||
lines.translation: I have renounced clever tricks, power and intellectual corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: daas apane kee raakhanahaar ||1||
lines.translation: God is the Protector of His servant. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap man mere raam raam ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, Raam, Raam, with love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar baahar terai sad sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Within your home, and beyond it, He is always with you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kee tek manai mahi raakh ||
lines.translation: Keep His Support in your mind.
